- **Video restoration and Smooth motion on Frameleaf Cloud work again (FL-1725):** sending a video to Frameleaf Cloud for restoration or Smooth motion was refused every time. It now goes through. Rotated phone videos, trimmed clips, clips with a changing frame rate and camcorder files are prepared so they come back right, with the sound in step. If Frameleaf Cloud can't do what you picked (4× restoration, or a Smooth motion speed above 120 frames a second), you're told before anything is sent or charged, with the setting that would work.
- **Desktop helpers (FL-1715):** a desktop that keeps failing on a model stops getting that work sooner, a desktop you pause or close no longer counts as failing, and work handed back by a desktop goes straight to another one.
- **Folder albums (FL-838):** turn folder albums on or off from the web, see a preview before you do, and spot folder albums by their badge.
- **iCloud (FL-1724, sync fixes):** iCloud sync downloads up to 100 photos at a time, a large first sync brings photos in before anything else, and a sync that fails no longer stays stuck.
- **Fixes (FL-1726, FL-1727, FL-1721, FL-1722):** landmark cards no longer repeat the same photo, workflow filters show their options properly, and Manager can verify a release built on Frameleaf's own build servers.
- **Save to Frameleaf 1.2.0 (FL-1729):** keyboard shortcuts open the extension (⌥⇧F or Alt+Shift+F), take a screenshot (⌥⇧S) and save the page as a link (⌥⇧L); change them on your browser's shortcuts page from the extension's Settings. The toolbar button shows how many items are waiting, or "!" when one needs you. Right-click a link to save it without opening it, or select text and right-click to save the page with that text as its note.
